title: Pyrazolyl-functionalised Ag(I)–NHC complexes: synthesis, characterisation, antibacterial activity, and computational investigation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,51209-51223
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA05570A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ngonidzashe Ruwizhi, Karen Pillay, Janade Moodley, Thishana Singh, Bernard Omondi, Muhammad D. Bala
Five pyrazolyl-functionalised azolium salts were synthesised. The complexes were tested in vitro against a broad spectrum of bacterial strains. DFT examined the electronic effects. SWISSADME predicted physicochemical and pharmacokinetic properties.
